newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lazard initiates two cable cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lazard initiates two cable cos.

text.p: -- Lazard Freres analyst Brian Barish said he initaited United International Holdings with a speculative buy and TV Filme Inc with a hold, his office said.
-- The analyst expects TV Filme, a Brazilian cable company, to report a loss of $0.08 per share in the current year and a loss of $0.10 per share in 1997, his office said.
-- Barish expects United International, a cable holding company with interests in Latin America, to produce operating cash flow of of $35.1 million in the fiscal year ending in February 1997.
